## Loading packages and data



```{r cars}
rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(lavaan) 
library(semTools)
library(tidySEM)
library(flextable)
library(officer)
library(knitr)
source("./gor-covid-19/final scripts/check_admissibility.R")

# Load the data

df <- read_csv("./gor-covid-19/final scripts/data/03_data_wide.csv")
```

## Configural model



```{r}
config.model <- '
  # Factoren per wave
  wb_w3  =~ NA*PBMHK301_w3  + PBMHK302_w3  + PBMHK303_w3  + PBMHK304_w3  + PBMHK305_w3
  wb_w4  =~ NA*PBMHK301_w4  + PBMHK302_w4  + PBMHK303_w4  + PBMHK304_w4  + PBMHK305_w4
  wb_w5  =~ NA*PBMHK301_w5  + PBMHK302_w5  + PBMHK303_w5  + PBMHK304_w5  + PBMHK305_w5
  wb_w6  =~ NA*PBMHK301_w6  + PBMHK302_w6  + PBMHK303_w6  + PBMHK304_w6  + PBMHK305_w6
  wb_w7  =~ NA*PBMHK301_w7  + PBMHK302_w7  + PBMHK303_w7  + PBMHK304_w7  + PBMHK305_w7
  wb_w8  =~ NA*PBMHK301_w8  + PBMHK302_w8  + PBMHK303_w8  + PBMHK304_w8  + PBMHK305_w8
  wb_w10 =~ NA*PBMHK301_w10 + PBMHK302_w10 + PBMHK303_w10 + PBMHK304_w10 + PBMHK305_w10
  wb_w12 =~ NA*PBMHK301_w12 + PBMHK302_w12 + PBMHK303_w12 + PBMHK304_w12 + PBMHK305_w12

  # Binnen-wave residual covariances
  PBMHK301_w3  ~~ PBMHK302_w3
  PBMHK301_w4  ~~ PBMHK302_w4
  PBMHK301_w5  ~~ PBMHK302_w5
  PBMHK301_w6  ~~ PBMHK302_w6
  PBMHK301_w7  ~~ PBMHK302_w7
  PBMHK301_w8  ~~ PBMHK302_w8
  PBMHK301_w10 ~~ PBMHK302_w10
  PBMHK301_w12 ~~ PBMHK302_w12


  # Tussen-wave residual covariances per item 
  # Volledige autocorrelatiestructuur: alle wave-paren per item

  # --- PBMHK301 ---
  PBMHK301_w3  ~~ PBMHK301_w4 + PBMHK301_w5 + PBMHK301_w6 + PBMHK301_w7 + PBMHK301_w8 + PBMHK301_w10 + PBMHK301_w12
  PBMHK301_w4  ~~ PBMHK301_w5 + PBMHK301_w6 + PBMHK301_w7 + PBMHK301_w8 + PBMHK301_w10 + PBMHK301_w12
  PBMHK301_w5  ~~ PBMHK301_w6 + PBMHK301_w7 + PBMHK301_w8 + PBMHK301_w10 + PBMHK301_w12

  PBMHK301_w8  ~~ PBMHK301_w10 + PBMHK301_w12
  PBMHK301_w10 ~~ PBMHK301_w12

  # --- PBMHK302 ---
  PBMHK302_w3  ~~ PBMHK302_w4 + PBMHK302_w5 + PBMHK302_w6 + PBMHK302_w7 + PBMHK302_w8 + PBMHK302_w10 + PBMHK302_w12
  PBMHK302_w4  ~~ PBMHK302_w5 + PBMHK302_w6 + PBMHK302_w7 + PBMHK302_w8 + PBMHK302_w10 + PBMHK302_w12
  PBMHK302_w5  ~~ PBMHK302_w6 + PBMHK302_w7 + PBMHK302_w8 + PBMHK302_w10 + PBMHK302_w12
  PBMHK302_w6  ~~ PBMHK302_w7 + PBMHK302_w8 + PBMHK302_w10 + PBMHK302_w12
  PBMHK302_w7  ~~ PBMHK302_w8 + PBMHK302_w10 + PBMHK302_w12
  PBMHK302_w8  ~~ PBMHK302_w10 + PBMHK302_w12
  PBMHK302_w10 ~~ PBMHK302_w12

  # --- PBMHK303 ---
  PBMHK303_w3  ~~ PBMHK303_w4 + PBMHK303_w5 + PBMHK303_w6 + PBMHK303_w7 + PBMHK303_w8 + PBMHK303_w10 + PBMHK303_w12
  PBMHK303_w4  ~~ PBMHK303_w5 + PBMHK303_w6 + PBMHK303_w7 + PBMHK303_w8 + PBMHK303_w10 + PBMHK303_w12
  PBMHK303_w5  ~~ PBMHK303_w6 + PBMHK303_w7 + PBMHK303_w8 + PBMHK303_w10 + PBMHK303_w12
  PBMHK303_w6  ~~ PBMHK303_w7 + PBMHK303_w8 + PBMHK303_w10 + PBMHK303_w12
  PBMHK303_w7  ~~ PBMHK303_w8 + PBMHK303_w10 + PBMHK303_w12

  PBMHK303_w10 ~~ PBMHK303_w12

  # --- PBMHK304 ---
  PBMHK304_w3  ~~ PBMHK304_w4 + PBMHK304_w5 + PBMHK304_w6 + PBMHK304_w7 + PBMHK304_w8 + PBMHK304_w10 + PBMHK304_w12
  PBMHK304_w4  ~~ PBMHK304_w5 + PBMHK304_w6 + PBMHK304_w7 + PBMHK304_w8 + PBMHK304_w10 + PBMHK304_w12
  PBMHK304_w5  ~~ PBMHK304_w6 + PBMHK304_w7 + PBMHK304_w8 + PBMHK304_w10 + PBMHK304_w12
  PBMHK304_w6  ~~ PBMHK304_w7 + PBMHK304_w8 + PBMHK304_w10 + PBMHK304_w12
  PBMHK304_w7  ~~ PBMHK304_w8 + PBMHK304_w10 + PBMHK304_w12
  PBMHK304_w8  ~~ PBMHK304_w10 + PBMHK304_w12
  PBMHK304_w10 ~~ PBMHK304_w12

  # --- PBMHK305 ---
  PBMHK305_w3  ~~ PBMHK305_w4 + PBMHK305_w5 + PBMHK305_w6 + PBMHK305_w7 + PBMHK305_w8 + PBMHK305_w10 + PBMHK305_w12
  PBMHK305_w4  ~~ PBMHK305_w5 + PBMHK305_w6 + PBMHK305_w7 + PBMHK305_w8 + PBMHK305_w10 + PBMHK305_w12
  PBMHK305_w5  ~~ PBMHK305_w6 + PBMHK305_w7 + PBMHK305_w8 + PBMHK305_w10 + PBMHK305_w12
  PBMHK305_w6  ~~ PBMHK305_w7 + PBMHK305_w8 + PBMHK305_w10 + PBMHK305_w12
  PBMHK305_w7  ~~ PBMHK305_w8 + PBMHK305_w10 + PBMHK305_w12
  PBMHK305_w8  ~~ PBMHK305_w10 + PBMHK305_w12
  PBMHK305_w10 ~~ PBMHK305_w12
'


config.fit <- cfa(config.model,
                data = df,
                estimator = "MLR",
                se = "robust",
                missing = "fiml",
                std.lv = TRUE)

saveRDS(config.fit, "./gor-covid-19/final scripts/models/config_model.rds")

#config.fit <- readRDS("./gor-covid-19/final scripts/models/config_model.rds")
summary(config.fit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
```

Check the modindices 

```{r}
print(head(modindices(config.fit, sort. = TRUE), 30))
```

Check admissability of the solution

```{r}
print(lavInspect(config.fit, "post.check"))
res <- check_admissibility(config.fit)
print(res)
```

```{r}
  PBMHK305_w4  ~~ PBMHK305_w5 + PBMHK305_w6 + PBMHK305_w7 + PBMHK305_w8 + PBMHK305_w10 + PBMHK305_w12
  PBMHK305_w5  ~~ PBMHK305_w6 + PBMHK305_w7 + PBMHK305_w8 + PBMHK305_w10 + PBMHK305_w12
  PBMHK305_w6  ~~ PBMHK305_w7 + PBMHK305_w8 + PBMHK305_w10 + PBMHK305_w12
  PBMHK305_w7  ~~ PBMHK305_w8 + PBMHK305_w10 + PBMHK305_w12
  PBMHK305_w8  ~~ PBMHK305_w10 + PBMHK305_w12
  PBMHK305_w10 ~~ PBMHK305_w12
  '

scalar.fit <- cfa(scalar.model,
              data = df,
              estimator = "MLR",
              se = "robust",
              missing = "fiml")

saveRDS(scalar.fit, "./gor-covid-19/final scripts/models/scalar_model.rds")

#scalar.fit <- readRDS("./gor-covid-19/final scripts/models/scalar_model.rds")
summary(scalar.fit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
```

##Saving factor predictions of scalar model

```{r}
predictions <- lavPredict(scalar.fit)
print(nrow(predictions))
print(nrow(df))
df_pred <- cbind(df, as.data.frame(predictions))
df_pred %>%  
  write_csv("./gor-covid-19/final scripts/data/04_data_wide.csv")
```

##Saving factor predictions long format

```{r}
df_pred_long <- df_pred %>%
  select(
    Koppelnummer,
    wb_w3, wb_w4, wb_w5, wb_w6,
    wb_w7, wb_w8, wb_w10, wb_w12
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wb_w"),
    names_to = "Ronde",
    names_prefix = "wb_w",
    values_to = "wb_fct"
  ) %>%
  mutate(wave = as.integer(Ronde)) %>%  
  write_csv("./gor-covid-19/final scripts/data/04_wb_fct.csv")
```
